design_philosophy.identity: The Anti-Bureaucracy Interface. We turn the stress of 'waiting in line' into a calm, predictable experience. The design is breathable, organic, and efficient—like a well-organized airport lounge, not a DMV.
core_principles: Clarity over Decoration: Data (time) is the hero.
Calm Efficiency: Use organic colors to soothe anxiety.
Community Driven: Make contributions (check-ins) feel like a civic duty/heroic act.
Mobile First Utility: Thumb-friendly navigation, large touch targets.

typography.instructions: Import 'Manrope' from Google Fonts. Use it for all Headings. Use 'Inter' for body text. Avoid using Manrope for long paragraphs.

usage_rules: Background is Warm Stone (#FAFAF9), not pure white.
Use 'accent' (Mint Green) for active states or highlights.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-lg hover:translate-y-[-2px] transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95 font-semibold px-8 py-3 rounded-full
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-full
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg

cards.default: bg-card border border-border shadow-sm rounded-xl p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300

inputs.default: h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border-input bg-background focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:border-transparent transition-all shadow-sm

navigation.bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border p-4 flex justify-around items-center z-50 shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
navigation.top_bar: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border p-4 flex justify-between items-center

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'Phosphor Icons' (via @phosphor-icons/react) if Lucide lacks a specific metaphor.

images.map_pin_style: Use CSS-based markers: A pulsing dot (bg-primary) with a larger semi-transparent ring.

motion.micro_interactions: All buttons must scale down slightly (active:scale-95) on click. List items should stagger-fade-in on load.
motion.page_transitions: Use simple opacity fade (0.3s ease-out). Avoid heavy sliding transitions that feel native-app-like but lag on web.
motion.loading: Use Skeleton loaders (Shadcn) that match the card layout exactly. No spinning wheels for page loads.

libraries.charts: Recharts (for 'Best Time to Visit' bar charts).
libraries.maps: Leaflet (react-leaflet) or Mapbox (if key available). Use OpenStreetMap tiles for free usage.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on 'status' badges (Green/Red/Yellow) has sufficient contrast. Use dark text on yellow backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements must be at least 44x44px. Add invisible padding to small icon buttons.
accessibility.labels: All icon-only buttons (like 'Search' or 'Filter') MUST have aria-label.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use flat, warm greys or textures.
Do not center-align long text. Left-align for readability.
Avoid 'native' alert dialogs. Use Shadcn Dialog/Drawer.
For the 'Crowd Level', use a visual gauge or progress bar, not just text.
Ensure the 'Check-in' button is the most prominent element on the Location Detail page.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with the custom colors defined above.
2. Create a 'Layout' component that handles the bottom navigation and max-width constraints.
3. Build the 'LocationCard' component first—it's the core UI element.
4. Use 'lucide-react' for icons (MapPin, Clock, Users, TrendingUp, Search).
5. For the 'Best Time' chart, use a simple BarChart from Recharts with a custom tooltip.
6. Implement the 'Add Location' flow as a Drawer (Sheet) or a multi-step Dialog, not a separate page if possible.
